findings.title: Description references secrets/credentials
findings.detail: Description of "get_candles" references sensitive artifacts (api_key, authorization, bearer). A tool description has no reason to mention credentials.

evidence.snippet: Candle history for one symbol, one page, oldest first, with your API key in the request's Authorization header (Bearer adk_live_... or adk_test_...) or in its X…

findings.title: Anomalously long tool description
findings.detail: Description of "get_candles" is 637 chars, far longer than this server's median (117). Overlong descriptions are a common place to bury instructions.

evidence.snippet: Candle history for one symbol, one page, oldest first, with your API key in the request's Authorization header (Bearer adk_live_... or adk_test_...) or in its X…

→ after: "Call this first to learn what is sold: the plans with their CHF prices and limits, the free trial, the continuous-feed rule, the redistribution terms, and links (signup, API reference, OpenAPI). To price a specific usage, use quote_price_for."
remediation: Re-review the tool before continuing to trust it.

remediation.title: Tool description changed since last scan
remediation.detail: Tool "list_symbols" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.
